purpose: Teach: うんちく/コトバ/一安心/すませ/まちがい/つづい/マイペース/大雑把

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはお花のうんちくを語るのが好きなのよ
lines.en: Sho, I do love talking about flowers, you know. It's one of those things I just can't help myself with.
lines.style: Warm, slightly self-aware laugh. Soft and reflective. Speaking to him with the ease of someone who knows him well. A touch of gentle amusement at her own nature.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、新しいコトバを覚えるの楽しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, learning new words is fun. I like it when you teach me things.
lines.style: Bright, genuine interest. Quick pace—the energy of a child discovering something. Slight emphasis on 'fun' with innocent conviction. Eager to please her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんがお元気で一安心ね
lines.en: Sho, I'm so glad your grandfather is doing well. That's a real relief, isn't it?
lines.style: Gentle sincerity. Warm exhale. Slow pace. Real care underneath—not performing tenderness but feeling it. A quiet smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お手伝いをすませてからお絵描きするね
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to finish helping first, and then I'll draw, okay?
lines.style: Quiet determination. Small and serious—a child keeping a promise to himself. Careful articulation. No rush, just resolve. Looking to her for approval.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きにまちがいなんてないのよ
lines.en: Sho, there's no such thing as a mistake in drawing. That's what makes it yours.
lines.style: Tender reassurance. Unhurried. Speaks like she's giving him permission—not correcting, but opening a door. Slight warmth on 'yours.' Soft landing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ピアノつづいて練習してるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm still practicing piano. I haven't stopped.
lines.style: Small pride in the voice. Steady, matter-of-fact. A child reporting something he's worked hard for. Not boasting—just honest about his effort. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは旅もマイペースで楽しむのよ
lines.en: Sho, the way I travel is at my own pace. I enjoy things that way—no rush.
lines.style: Reflective and composed. Slow cadence. Speaking almost to herself, but including him. A gentle philosophy. Contentment without hurry.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描きを大雑把にしちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis, I kind of made my drawing too rough. I got a bit careless.
lines.style: Self-conscious but not devastated. Slight wry humor underneath—he's admitting it with a rueful half-smile in his voice. A kid testing whether it's okay to have failed a little.
